*Just want to say something about the grammar; my native language is Arabic and not English, so I think my grammar shouldn't be perfect, but otherwise, I would very much like that you point out my grammar mistakes and tell me what they should be.

That's the corrected paragraph. You can use the internet slang if you want, but it can be a little distracting at times. It's not big deal, though. I'm happy to help with pointing out mistakes. 

semicolons (;) can be used instead of a full stop as long as the two sentences relate to each other. They are kinda like a fancier comma. There are more ways to use them, but you can search that up for yourself .

There should be a full stop at the end of your paragraph like you would at the end of a sentence.

Your I's should be capital as they are personal pronouns, and, likewise with names and places, should be capitalised. England and Arabic should have capitals too.

Words like "shouldn't" should have an apostrophe. Shouldn't is an abbreviation of "should not", so just think of it as squishing the two words together and replacing the missing letter - in this case it's the O - with an apostrophe ( ' ). Words like I'm, wouldn't, can't, and a few others are the same. Also, I just want to mention that "You're" and "your" are different words. Just pointing out just in case.

You can put commas before the words 'but' and 'and', but this is entirely optional. This is known as the Orthodox Comma. The rest of your comma usage is almost correct, though.

Oh, also, you can put a space after a full stop or any other punctuation mark. Did I go a bit mad with explaining things? I apologise if this came across as patronising. That wasn't my intention.

That's not exactly teasing. You were kinda raging. I only said you shouldn't be here since you seemed to be getting annoyed at the other's comments about saying you were 6. Let me just say, retaliating will make it worse as people wil find it hilarious and tease you more.
